name: (10) Quietus — 3 Advanced — Ripples of the Heart

system.description: You leave an emotion within the bloodstream of a mortal vessel; any other vampire who later drinks from that vessel experiences the same emotion as if it were his own. You must drink at least one Blood Trait from the subject, then spend a minute in physical contact while concentrating on the emotion to be left behind. Spend a Social Trait and a Blood Trait. For the next month, anyone else who drinks from that mortal must win a Static Mental Challenge against a difficulty equal to your permanent Social Traits or experience the emotion you left in the mortal's blood — a momentary mood swing for one Blood Trait taken, a significant demeanor shift for two, or a complete (and potentially catastrophic) change in emotional state for three or more. A mortal's blood can only carry one emotion at a time, and subsequent attempts have no effect until the previous application fades. You are immune to the effects of your own use of this power.
system.bloodCost: 1 Blood Trait drunk, plus 1 Blood Trait and 1 Social Trait spent
